cli.error.auth: Ingqondo {brain} yenqabe ukhiye. Wuhlole, noma uxhume enye ingqondo.
cli.error.credits: Ingqondo {brain} iphelelwe amakhredithi. Engeza amanye ku-akhawunti yakho, noma ukhethe enye ingqondo.
cli.error.rate_limit: Ingqondo {brain} imatasa noma umkhawulo wakho ufinyelelwe. Linda kancane bese uzama futhi.
cli.error.bad_request: Ingqondo {brain} ayisamukelanga isicelo. Zama enye inguqulo yale ngqondo.
cli.error.not_found: Ingqondo {brain} ayiyitholanga le nguqulo. Khetha enye.
cli.error.server: Ingqondo {brain} inenkinga. Zama futhi ngemuva kwesikhashana.
cli.error.bad_response: Ingqondo {brain} ithumele impendulo engafundeki. Zama futhi.
cli.notSync: Ifolda {folder} akuyona ifolda evumelanisiwe. Nikeza leyo oyikhethe ku-Izilungiselelo › Idatha yakho.
cli.noBrain: Ayikho ingqondo engaphendula okwamanje. Faka ukhiye wayo endaweni yokusebenza, njenge-ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, noma ungene ku-Claude Code.
cli.login.missing: I-Claude Code ayikho kule khompyutha. Yifake bese uzama futhi, noma ufake ukhiye wengqondo endaweni yokusebenza, njenge-ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
cli.help.acp: Umsizi {name} kusihleli sakho, efoldeni yakho evumelanisiwe.
cli.help.brain: --brain ikhetha ingqondo, njenge-anthropic, openrouter noma claudecode; ukhiye wayo uvela endaweni yokusebenza.
cli.help.gateway: Isango, lezinsiza isiphequluli esingakwazi ukuzifinyelela, njenge-Gmail noma i-Slack.
cli.gateway.origin: Biza ikheli olivula esipheqululini sakho, njengokuthi https://{domain}: --origin <ikheli>.
cli.gateway.ready: Isango liphendula ku: {address}. Libize ku-Izilungiselelo › Izixhumano.
